gate_declarations.source: Per-plan gate-chain declaration for AFC-2026-10-11 Phase 1 (test-engineer skill: red-then-green, mutation, changed-line coverage). Thresholds are Planning Test Engineer proposals approved with the package at the integrated review.
gate_declarations.typed_gap_rule: A declared claim with a missing tool, a fetch/CLI failure or a not_run outcome is typed gap TOOL_MISSING or NOT_RUN with the exact error, never PASS.

ci.assurance: Assurance Test Engineer at the Phase 1 boundary reruns every claim below on the exact candidate

red_then_green.tool: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/ci/tests (CMD-RED suite gate, then CMD-GATE-HYGIENE)
red_then_green.threshold: every test id tagged with an S09T SEIT row fails by assertion at S09T and passes at S09; same ids; test-file sha256 unchanged

changed_line_coverage.threshold: >= 90 % of changed lines in tools/ci/*.py (vendored check_workflows.py excluded)
changed_line_coverage.typed_gap: gate.sh shell lines: TOOL_MISSING (kcov absent), never PASS

mutation.threshold: mutation score >= 0.70 over check_paths.py and check_docs.py
mutation.typed_gap: gate.sh: no shell mutation tool, TOOL_MISSING; vendored check_workflows.py excluded (tested at its D4-B source)

red_then_green.tool: bash hooks/test-ci-gate-hook.sh (CMD-RED suite hook, then CMD-HOOK-TEST)
red_then_green.threshold: same test ids red at S11T and green at S11; test-file sha256 unchanged

changed_line_coverage.tool: coverage.py >= 7 via uv, installer run through $AFC_HOOK_PY (CMD-COVERAGE-HOOK)
changed_line_coverage.typed_gap: hooks/ci-gate-hook.sh shell lines: TOOL_MISSING (kcov absent), never PASS

mutation.tool: mutmut 2.x via uvx, runner bash hooks/test-ci-gate-hook.sh (CMD-MUTATION-HOOK)
mutation.typed_gap: hooks/ci-gate-hook.sh: no shell mutation tool, TOOL_MISSING

If the owner selects option B, the gate template, hook installer, workflow checker and D5 scripts move to the primary profile with tdd and this SEIT is regenerated with ci-lane claims for them.

reviewer.tool: phase Reviewer on the lane profile route with CMD-OCR-DELEGATE and the Reverify not-applicable line
reviewer.threshold: one review per Phase 1 PR, at most one repair round, then deterministic closure
reviewer.typed_gap: OCR failure: typed gap with the exact error

evidence_and_pass_fail.evidence: Command output captured per run with the candidate SHA (git rev-parse HEAD); author receipts are diagnostic-only; assurance receipts come from a fresh Assurance Test Engineer rerunning the same commands (ci lane)
evidence_and_pass_fail.pass_fail: A requirement row PASSES iff every SEIT-AFC proof row citing it passes its pass_fail_rule on the exact candidate. A typed gap (TOOL_MISSING, NOT_RUN, OWNER_ACTION_PENDING) is never PASS. NOT_APPLICABLE counts only with a non-empty reason in gate_declarations. RISK-AFC-17 is OPEN_CARRIED at Phase 1 closeout.
evidence_and_pass_fail.tdd_receipt: Each red-expected row needs CMD-RED on the Test Implementer candidate and the green command on the Product Implementer candidate over the same test ids, with test-file sha256 recorded in both
evidence_and_pass_fail.sensitive_evidence: No credential, account name, email or absolute home path in committed evidence; hook-demo and review evidence stay outside the repository

anomaly_corrective_closure.anomaly: Any FAIL, GAP gate line, typed gap or unexpected red/green result is an anomaly recorded with command, candidate SHA, exact output and file:line where applicable
anomaly_corrective_closure.classification: product defect (route to the lane implementer), harness/environment defect (fix the harness, rerun; not a product finding), expected negative test, owner action pending (typed gap)
anomaly_corrective_closure.corrective: One repair round per Phase 1 PR after review, then deterministic verification; no further review round unless the owner asks or scope changed
anomaly_corrective_closure.closure: Deterministic rerun PASS on the repaired candidate; a merged regression is reverted by a revert PR (no force-push); harness wiring restored by CMD-HOOK-RESTORE; skill links removed per evidence/skill-links.txt
